_about: Events GameTora's pages do not carry, in the normalized cache shape. app/gametora.py merges each into its page's `events` / `events_ja` on dump (and `python -m app.gametora supplement` merges them into the files already cached), but only while the page has no event of that title, so a GameTora entry always wins once it exists.

chara:109701.supplement: Still in Love's Tiara-route secret: win Fillies' Review, Oka Sho, Flora S, Oaks, Rose S and Shuka Sho in Classic; plays after the Shuka Sho (Classic, Late October). Rewards per BlueStacks and kamigame (Power/Guts +35, SP +25, hints 遊びはおしまいっ！ / むきだしの情熱 +2); GameTora's page (checked 2026-09-27) has no secret section.
